target_customer: Hospice, home health and skilled nursing providers
problem: Clinicians in post-acute care spend hours on documentation and compliance. Moonset records visits and IDG meetings, writes notes and writes them back to the customer's EHR.
product_category: AI clinical documentation for post-acute care

technical_complexity.rationale: Ambient transcription and structured note generation with HIPAA compliance and integrations to PointClickCare, MatrixCare, Homecare Homebase, Netsmart, WellSky and Axxess.

defensibility.rationale: EHR integrations and workflow embedding help, but EHR vendors can ship their own scribes.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: WellSky launched an ambient scribe in October 2025 and Homecare Homebase announced Curate Scribe in March 2026, both after the batch, which show incumbents absorbing the wedge.

market_need_then: Documentation burden in hospice is high per company claims such as 1 to 2 hours saved per nurse per day at one hospice customer. No independent data found.

identity.logo: Not described by any source found
identity.voice_and_tone: Warm, confident, mission driven, theme of unburdening the care team

rebrands.why: Not stated; one aggregator search summary says the company was formerly Summed AI

brand_strength.rationale: A soft name fits hospice, but no press or community about the brand found.

outcome_analysis: Moonset is active and claims 50,000 hours saved and a named hospice case study, all self reported. Larger EHR vendors launched competing scribes in 2025 and 2026, a risk, but no outcome event or funding was verified, so this is an early stage company with an open result.
notes: Founder education and prior employers are not on the YC page and were not found. Unverified: Caplight lists $500K total funding with YC, another directory says none raised; no round recorded. Team size shown as 4 or 7 in different directories. Formerly Summed AI per one search summary only (YC also has a summed-ai page); not confirmed. Competitor sources are all dated 2025 or later, so the as-of-founding list is empty and later entrants are in takeover_risk_then.
